# 出入境旅游服务质量苗头问题日报

**日期**：2026-10-23

## 一、本期重点关注

今日无重点关注苗头。

## 二、入境游服务质量相关

### （一）境外数据

#### （1）个人发布内容

- 称赞｜上海：英国游客发布上海"坦率评价"视频，评论区多国游客称体验描述与自身经历高度一致（@Pierina.24，"I've seen more than a hundreds reviews of China from travelers and the report is virtually verbatim"）[YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xiuqYwmFK7Q)
- 称赞｜北京：游客称长城之行令人向往，表达赴华意愿（@arzookiyani5216，"I need to visit Chinaaaaaa 😍😍😍"）[YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=12Kv9q6YM5A)
- 称赞｜上海：游客称上海是包容性强的城市，欢迎再次到访（@BoostHubp4o，"Shanghai is a very inclusive city where people from all over can find something they like"）[YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xiuqYwmFK7Q)
- 中性｜上海：在华16年的美国居民称上海体验好但消费明显高于中国其他地区，建议游客深入小城市（@michaelgec3344，"it's very expensive compared to other parts of China... get into smaller cities things get much cheaper"）[YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xiuqYwmFK7Q)
- 称赞｜中国：游客称入境攻略详尽、对首次赴华者友好（@bunmiabegunde3617，"Detailed to help anyone even a first timer"）[YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1OpBt2Yw3NI)
- 称赞｜中国：英国游客称熟悉支付应用与扫码后赴华旅行"轻而易举"，并称中国安全、多元、性价比高（@thebuddhaheartsutra，"Once you familiarise yourself with payment apps and how things work (like scanning QR codes), travel in China becomes a breeze"）[YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xiuqYwmFK7Q)
- 中性｜北京：游客发布故宫游览提示，称需凭护照在线预约、周一闭馆、天安门广场需单独预约，人均约18美元（@nissimgoes，"Book online with your passport · closed on Mondays... Tiananmen Square needs its own booking"）[YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=InyfR387nLw)
- 称赞｜云南、北京：游客称乘国航自云南返京，机组谦和热情有礼（Facebook，"A special mention to the incredibly humble, warm, and courteous Air China staff"）[Facebook](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi_?oc=5)
- 称赞｜北京：旅行社从业者称一名客人七年后重游长城，仍被当年同一导游一眼认出（Instagram，"Seven years later — and he recognised him immediately"）[Instagram](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiUkFVX3lxTFA3RHNLMDFWcVpScTFIejQ4b3NqUklGWTd3YXVVNUdiemdvR2VRLVRpeEh5MVRFckNlOHJ0aEhBQkthTTFUNGtyNkx4b1kyRkNxQVE?oc=5)

#### （2）媒体发布

- **官媒海外版**：今日无。

- **其他境外媒体**：
  - 加拿大护照免签入境：Reddit 用户咨询持加拿大护照经台湾（台中）赴大陆短期行程，确认加籍可享30天免签，询问近期实际入境体验；另有报道称中国对外国游客吸引力上升、免签入境人数增长24.1%。[u/Extreme-Habit-4356](https://reddit.com/r/travel/comments/1xc6xzj/traveling_from_taiwan_taichung_to_china_on_a/)、[Medcom.id](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMibEFVX3lxTFA0cTNEcnd6QlZoRFdqRnVlSFo1Z2RfQ0RRR0ZXVHpzbzVpLUFRMG5id3dXM2NENFRXS0s5bHU2VktnQmRIUmpRV3N1RUNLWTBRZDdWYnlWcWJhblNpNlNaQnd4emJFd3AwYzVsYg?oc=5)
  - 赴华旅游行前须知：多平台内容聚焦赴华前需提前办妥的事项，包括签证、支付等；有视频称"赴华旅行比想象中更容易"，也有评论表达负面抵触情绪。[Chiis.nothing](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CxvNVNxe7aA)、[Allen Zhang Travel](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=m71P0SJetu8)、[Instagram · nextmeridian.expedition](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DXbJx4kk3kP/)
  - 游客遭遇诈骗：旅游攻略类网站与问答平台集中提示中国景区常见骗局，包括低价团、"热情"茶邀约、玉器店及黑车等。[Zhangjiajie Holiday China Tour & Travel](https://www.zhangjiajieholiday.com/China_Guide/China_Travel_Tips/383.html)、[Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/fb-answers/common-scams-in-china-tourist-areas/?locale=fa_IR)、[Quora](https://www.quora.com/If-you-are-visiting-China-what-scams-do-you-need-to-watch-out-for-and-prevent-from-happening)
  - 出租车宰客：游客反映在广州北京路乘出租车（非网约车）15分钟车程遭绕路多收费；另有游客称在义乌机场附近被索要双倍车费（应40—50元、实收100元）。[Facebook · China Travel Guide & Visa News](https://www.facebook.com/groups/chinatravelguidevisa/posts/2919618468224477/)、[Reddit · r/China](https://www.reddit.com/r/China/comments/13s1aac/taxi_driver_scammed_me_charged_197_km_for_a_107/)、[Facebook · Foreigners in China](https://www.facebook.com/groups/foreignersinchina1/posts/2504364866403097/)
  - 美对华旅行警告：美方在赴华旅行提示中新增"不当拘押"警告内容，相关报道经多家外媒转载。[AgroLatam](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivAFBVV95cUxPX1lBcl9RQ2hOUWdVQ2dhSmJnRm5WU3E5cE9lR2R0SUMzWExtNURXYVlOTzZWa0tqN3VZTVB2OFp1ei1UckpjamhqeF9DdEh4U2M3cjh0OGxWVW1XSGJVQ2lwYnQ5SW1WS0NqSHZ1anJ1RW1BV3VUZS00cDhIU2I4UlczbXZiX2VfLTdrLXBmcmhNZUF4dW5HSzNIMUxIU2dmc1FqbERSWlR1RjJNVkhudmVtZERaQndBM1F3dg?oc=5)、[The Traveler](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilAFBVV95cUxPX2gtNURnOUxXVW1GdVBhWnRJUUdWLWRObXJmNFVtZmhNM3VPc054YU5aaGd4a2NNRFp3dHI1MVU4QXkxZXVNU0poZUltNzJ1WU5BbTlJWGdaQkFFWU5jOElKTFZGVzVQTGtjOW54Y1lRUEItYU5ZUzVyYkdpY2J3aTZyeFA0OGdsZkJrLTVtSGc1VEhr?oc=5)

## 四、其他苗头与政策动态

- 中国跟团游体验（评分3.9）：境外游客在社交平台回顾去年11月随团赴华行程，对景观、历史、文化与美食给予正面评价。[Facebook](https://news.google.?oc=5)
- 境外游客购物热潮（评分3.8）：外媒关注"China Haul"现象，外国游客空箱来华、满载离境；另有美国游客称在华应用、支付、社交等体验与别国差异显著。[X](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiZ0FVX3lxTFBTUXFhWGR3NTdiQ2J1bndHUFVYRkgwMXhSdldxaWxhaFd6dWZwYk9oNkt2Tk9xbVJjMUs1VUlHb3pJSXNqOVhnQmM4WEtTSDRza0thelpRTHJiSXdJSWwwWDRhbVJBemM?oc=5)、[Instagram · christian.grossi_](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DYsVQRzuvND/)
- 重庆文旅演艺（评分3.8）：境外游客称重庆1949演出为在华最佳观演体验之一，对360度旋转舞台与整体制作给予高度评价。[Facebook](https://news.google.?oc=5)、[Instagram](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiVkFVX3lxTE0zWWN1MlR0STRRMHBuWVpuN0hJYTl0NHgycWpacVJDT3J5THZqV01ubnBxQ1hSSmtJZVRIUzE3RkItdm5WQ0x1U0NMNkpBbXJLanR3c21B?oc=5)
